title: Super Mario Land
source: https://github.com/kaspermeerts/supermarioland/blob/618d00ed6c33/wram.asm and hram.asm (labels wScore, wLives, wGameTimer, hWorldAndLevel, hCoins)
notes: Checked on MC-Gameboy_20260908 and 20260908b against the live picture 2026-09-07 with the (World) ROM, CRC 90776841 (the disassembly is Rev A; every address held). Score: 200 on screen read 00 02 00, 100 read 00 01 00 (packed BCD, high byte first). Lives: MARIOx02 read 2, x01 after a death 1, x00 0; not exercised above 9. Timer: 396 on screen read DA00 14, DA01 96, DA02 03; DA00 is the frame sub-counter, DA01 the BCD tens and ones, DA02 the hundreds; 400, 384, 370, 218, 193 and the reset to 400 after a death matched. World and level: one HRAM byte, world in the high nibble, level in the low: 1-1 read 0x11, the demo's 1-2 read 0x12 and 3-3 read 0x33. Coins: x01 on screen read 01 after the first ? block; above 9 not exercised (BCD assumed, as the score is). HRAM ($FF80-$FFFE) needs the 64 KB image of MC-Gameboy_20260908b or later; on the first build the world and coins lines drop out. Seen but not shipped: $FFB3 was 0x0F on the title screen and 0x00 or 0x04 in play; $FF99 (power) stayed 0 as small Mario.
